item.description: The Curse of Talent: Aaron Ofoyrwoth and the Rugby Cranes’ Rollercoaster A Triumphant Debut in Luo Land (June 2019) Serving a suspension as a school boy in June 2019, I decided to catch a bus to Luo land in neighbouring Kenya to catch the first leg of the decades’ old rivalry (the Elgon Cup) at the Mamboleo Showground in Kisumu.
